args.sql:
SELECT 
    T1.opsregistry AS operation_registry_id,
    T2.storecapm3 AS storage_capacity_m3,
    T2.storeavailm3 AS storage_availability_m3,
    T1.supplyflowstate AS current_supply_flow_state
FROM 
    operations AS T1
JOIN 
    distributionhubs AS T2 ON T1.opshubref = T2.hubregistry
WHERE 
    T1.resourceallocstate = 'Critical'
ORDER BY 
    T1.opsregistry;
